demo_chips: How much does a kitchen remodel cost?
How do I book a free consultation?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach iHome Built at (360) 624-8208 or info@ihomebuilt.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.q: Is the price fixed once we agree on it?
faqs.a: Yes - we provide fixed pricing based on the agreed scope of work and selections. If the scope changes during the project, we document those changes through clear change orders before proceeding.

faqs.q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
faqs.a: Most kitchen remodels take 6-8 weeks of construction once permits and materials are ready. The planning phase - consultation, proposal preparation, design work and permitting - typically takes 2-4 weeks.

faqs.q: What are the biggest cost drivers?
faqs.a: Cabinetry, structural layout changes, countertops and finishes, and electrical and plumbing complexity. Small cosmetic updates may cost significantly less than projects involving structural changes or custom cabinetry.

pricing.summary: Most of our kitchen projects fall between $40,000 and $80,000, depending on cabinet quality and customization, countertop materials, layout changes, electrical and plumbing modifications, flooring integration, and appliance upgrades. Each project receives a fixed-price proposal based on the detailed scope and selections - and the consultation is free.
